CBD Dog Treats for Anxiety & Joint Relief-300mg | Green DR

Our CBD Dog Treats for Anxiety & Joint Relief-300mg | Green DR are specially formulated to help your pup stay calm, reduce joint pain, and promote daily wellness. Whether your dog struggles with anxiety, joint stiffness, or age-related discomfort, these full-spectrum hemp extract treats offer natural relief.

Each tasty treat delivers 30mg of premium CBD to support anxiety relief, stress reduction, joint health, and inflammation control. Made with all-natural, pet-safe ingredients, our CBD Dog Treats for Anxiety & Joint Relief-300mg | Green DR are available in beef or peanut butter flavors and are vet-recommended for safe daily use.
